amendment_reason: The Owner explicitly approved a USD 3.50 absolute ceiling for the exact immutable free-quote basis plan DEDDE7F2. HYP-002 remains terminal parked in the registry because payment authority does not alter its frozen market mechanism, data contract or evidence state. This higher-priority current Owner instruction plus V13 grants only one serial design-source acquisition attempt after a fresh free live re-quote of the same 658 request identities.

owner_authorization.scope: one serial paid acquisition of exactly the 658 frozen 2019-2020 design PRE/LATE request identities only, after a fresh free live re-quote
owner_authorization.ceiling_behavior: If the fresh live quote exceeds USD 3.50, stop before the first timeseries call and preserve a no-paid blocker receipt. The ceiling is aggregate, not per request.

required_behavior: Bind V13, the exact Owner verbatim approval, USD 3.50, immutable DEDDE7F2 evidence, current canonical registry SHA and exact three-row HYP-002 parked history before API-key access, client creation, root mutation or lock creation.
Do not append or rewrite the terminal HYP-002 registry history merely to represent payment authority; V13 is a scoped authority amendment, not a market-state transition.

Expose one production design-acquire entrypoint only. It must require the exact authorization basis plan ID DEDDE7F2 and exact aggregate ceiling USD 3.50; no looser CLI value or code override is accepted.
Acquire one exclusive paid lock before the fresh live re-quote and hold it through complete serial download or fail-closed termination.
Freshly quote the exact 658 canonical PRE/LATE identities using only free metadata methods. Preserve a live plan and receipt distinct from immutable DEDDE7F2 historical quote evidence.
Revalidate canonical registry, immutable evidence, exact request identities, V13 authority, SDK and D-side capacity immediately before the first paid timeseries call.
If live aggregate quote is greater than USD 3.50 or capacity fails, write a reconciled no-paid blocker receipt and stop with timeseries_calls=0.

If live quote is within ceiling, call timeseries.get_range serially once per not-yet-manifested request. Journal an in_flight identity before every paid call; after any exception or ambiguous completion preserve in_flight and prohibit automatic retry.

Use request_id rather than event_clock_id as the unique design identity because each clock has PRE and LATE requests. Validate exact half-open bounds, filename containment, byte count, SHA-256 and full DBN decode/record count before adopting each file.
A complete zero-record DBN is charged source_empty evidence and must never be retried. Reject partial, duplicate, extra, symlinked, path-escaped, unmanifested or hash-mismatched artifacts.

On success require 658/658 manifested identities, no unresolved in_flight/partial files, all DBN files validator-clean, aggregate estimate <= USD 3.50, and a hash-bound acquisition authority receipt. Do not duplicate the multi-gigabyte raw corpus into an evidence mirror.
Preserve validation-source sealing, EURUSD outcome sealing, no-MQL5/no-Model0/no-chart/no-live boundaries and every V11/V12 retry/security/immutable-evidence guard.
red_first_acceptance_tests: Missing/mutated V13, Owner text, basis plan ID, exact USD 3.50, registry row/history or immutable DEDDE7F2 evidence blocks before key/client/root/lock/remote access.
A direct function call cannot bypass V13 authority; alternate expected plan ID, higher/lower CLI ceiling, NaN/Infinity, alternate root or alternate request list fails closed.
Live re-quote above USD 3.50 or capacity below the frozen rule preserves no-paid evidence and produces zero timeseries calls.
Live re-quote at or below USD 3.50 revalidates exact authority and registry after the quote and before the first paid call.

Design manifest/resume validates 658 request_id identities and rejects duplicate event-clock ambiguity, partial/unmanifested files, path escape, symlink, byte/SHA/record drift and unresolved in_flight retry.
One successful fake-client campaign downloads 658 identities serially, records exactly 658 paid calls, validates all DBN outputs and reaches DOWNLOADED_FULL_DBN_VALIDATION_PASS.
A paid-call failure preserves in_flight, makes no automatic retry and cannot be resumed without manual reconciliation.
All prior 104 tests remain green; production source and tests receive independent read-only review before any live command.
